plugins.photosPermission: FireGIS needs access to your photos so you can attach scene photographs to an incident report.
plugins.cameraPermission: FireGIS needs camera access so you can take scene photographs for an incident report.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FireGIS shares your location with the command center while you are on duty, including standby and active dispatches.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: FireGIS shares your location while on duty even with the screen off: every 30 seconds on standby and more often during a dispatch. Sharing stops when you are off duty.
